name: Espresso
description: A single or double shot of our signature house blend — bold, bright, and smooth with a caramel crema.

name: Americano
description: Two ristretto shots pulled long with hot water. Full-bodied, clean, and endlessly drinkable.

name: Macchiato
description: Double espresso 'stained' with a generous dollop of velvety steamed milk foam. Intensity with a soft finish.

name: Cortado
description: Equal parts espresso and warm whole milk — a perfectly balanced shot for those who like it strong but smooth.

name: Flat White
description: Two ristretto shots topped with silky micro-foam poured in a thin, even layer. Stronger than a latte, smoother than a cap.

name: The Crew Signature Latte
description: Our house blend slow-drip cold brew stirred with brown butter caramel, topped with sweet cream and a pinch of flaky sea salt.

name: Brown Sugar Oat Latte
description: Espresso shaken over ice with brown sugar syrup, then streamed with cold oat milk. The perfect everyday indulgence.

name: Lavender Fog Latte
description: Locally sourced lavender syrup and honey swirled into steamed oat milk with a double shot. Floral, calming, memorable.

name: Golden Turmeric Latte
description: Turmeric, ginger, black pepper, and raw honey whisked into steamed milk. A warming, caffeine-free ritual.

name: Maple Pecan Cold Brew
description: Our 12-hour cold brew concentrate over ice, sweetened with pure maple syrup and finished with toasted pecan cream.

name: Butter Croissant
description: Three-day laminated dough — 27 layers of pure butter pastry with a shattering crust and honeyed crumb. Baked fresh each morning.

name: Morning Glory Muffin
description: Packed with grated carrot, apple, raisin, toasted coconut, and orange zest. Dense, moist, and genuinely filling.

name: Cinnamon Roll
description: Slow-risen brioche dough rolled with brown butter and cinnamon sugar, finished with a generous cream cheese glaze.

name: Banana Walnut Loaf
description: Dark, moist banana bread with roughly chopped walnuts and a dark chocolate swirl. Served warm by request.

name: Chocolate Almond Tart
description: Dark Valrhona ganache set in a buttery almond frangipane shell, dusted with cocoa. Best at room temperature.

name: Egg & Aged Cheddar
description: Scrambled free-range egg, aged white cheddar, baby arugula, and whole-grain mustard on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Smoked Turkey Pesto
description: Sliced smoked turkey, sun-dried tomato pesto, provolone, and baby spinach pressed on sourdough. Available warm.

name: The Veggie Club
description: Roasted red pepper hummus, sliced avocado, cucumber, pickled red onion, and sprouts on toasted multigrain.

name: Prosciutto & Brie
description: Prosciutto di Parma, triple-cream brie, fig jam, and peppery rocket on a crusty French demi-baguette.

name: Matcha Green Tea Latte
description: Ceremonial-grade Japanese matcha whisked into steamed milk with a touch of raw honey. Earthy, sweet, and vivid.

name: Classic Lemonade
description: Fresh-squeezed lemons, pure cane sugar, and cold sparkling water over crushed ice. No shortcuts, no syrups.

name: Fresh Mint Tea
description: A generous handful of whole fresh mint leaves steeped to order in near-boiling water. Served in a glass pot.

name: Strawberry Basil Lemonade
description: Our house lemonade muddled with fresh strawberries and a sprig of basil. Bright, unexpected, and refreshing.
